let a: number;
switch (1) { case 1: a = 1; break; }
console.log(a);
function union(flag: boolean) {
  let result: number;
  switch (flag ? 'first' : 'second') {
    case 'first': result = 1; break;
    case 'second': result = 2; break;
  }
  return result;
}
let c: number;
switch (typeof 1) { case 'number': c = 1; }
console.log(c);
console.log(union(false));
